title: Finish agent setup with focused install readiness
verification: Source reports missing harness CLIs and unverified sign-in as WARN for install and session checks, allowing setup readiness and onboarding. Worker launch eligibility refuses missing surfaces and reported stale credentials with per-surface recovery. Shared resolution checks fixed and versioned desktop or IDE bundles without adding versioned directories to shell PATH; released delivery remains unproven. Outside the project folder, session-hook-registration becomes one pending step directing a new project chat to run yoke doctor run --session; inside the folder it remains required. Agent setup returns finished_with_problems with exit 1 when install checks fail or the hook evaluator could not start. Its guidance names the failed checks and puts recovery before next steps. Install readiness, pending verification and recovery appear in durable reports and human/JSON output. Setup checks the live project binding before binding again and reuses the same active installation and repository. Fresh installs write no Git hooks. Refresh removes legacy Yoke shims from the common Git directory shared with linked worktrees and reports the removed hooks.
